name: Azimuth Settings
author: Max (byzyn4ik)
description: All of Azimuth's per-game settings as rows of the game's own settings pages: frame rate, V-sync, resolution, aspect ratio, display mode, HDR, the graphics preset and its nine details and anti-aliasing on the Video page; audio output, volume, speech and text language on the Audio page. Forza Horizon 2 and Fast & Furious; frame rate, display mode, shadow distance and redraw and volume apply at once. Do not install together with Azimuth Graphics Options.
